title: Nightly Schedule Guard
desc: PreToolUse hook: blocks Bash/PowerShell until CLAUDE.md CronCreate entries are registered in session JSONL. Global hook in ~/.claude/settings.json.
steps: PURPOSE: blocks Bash/PowerShell until all ### CronCreate(...) headings in CLAUDE.md have matching session JSONL entries
SATISFY: call CronCreate tool for each heading in CLAUDE.md at session start -- cron= and prompt= must match exactly
EXEMPT: CronCreate/CronList/CronDelete tools; Edit/Write on CLAUDE.md; any cmd matching wkappbot skill*
AUTO-INJECT: if CLAUDE.md has no CronCreate headings and no Nightly Schedules section, appends sample template

DENY MSG: [NIGHTLY-GUARD] CronCreate missing or prompt mismatch for: <cron>. Prompt must match CLAUDE.md exactly. wkappbot skill* exempt. -> Fix: call CronCreate tool for each heading, or run: wkappbot skill read nightly-schedule-guard
BUG FIXES 2026-05-25: slug regex, cwd backslash, Join-String PS5.1 incompatible -- all fixed
GLOBALIZATION 2026-05-25: moved from per-repo settings.local.json to global ~/.claude/settings.json (now covers all repos)
author: claude
